segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin describe this sorbet as controlling shine and keeping oil at bay while still providing moisture, with several calling it life-changing for oil control.
segments.dry: Reports from dry-skin users are split: some say it keeps their skin from drying out and feels plump and soft, while others find it absorbs too fast leaving skin feeling drier, tight, or in need of a heavier night cream.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers consistently praise it for balancing oily T-zones with drier areas, hydrating without greasiness and wearing well under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers generally report no irritation, breakouts, or reaction and appreciate the fragrance-free or near-fragrance-free formula, though one reviewer with sensitive skin reports tightness, redness, and splotchiness after use.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing their skin as mature say it keeps skin moisturized and bouncy without feeling greasy and recommend it for that age group.
segments.normal: One reviewer pairing the product with a serum on normal-appearing skin found it hydrating overnight but noted it dried up quickly when used alone.

concerns.aging: Mature-skin reviewers report skin feels moisturized, bouncy, and less weighed down, with one noting brighter, more youthful-looking skin and reduced pore appearance.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those in dry climates or cold months, report 24-48 hours of hydration, softness, and plumpness; a few say it absorbs too fast and leaves skin feeling drier or tight, especially without layering under a serum.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically notes no redness even used near the eye area, while another with dry/sensitive skin reports her skin appeared red and splotchy after use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with dry or sensitive skin most often describe the product as non-irritating and soothing, though one describes it as feeling like a harsh salicylic acid toner with no soothing effect.
concerns.spots: One reviewer credits it with reducing acne, and another with acne-prone skin reports no new breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts and one credits the built-in salicylic acid with keeping skin clear.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination-skin reviewers repeatedly report a shine-free, matte finish lasting through the day without feeling greasy or heavy.

aspects.libelle: Absorbs too quickly, insufficient for dry skin
Elegant jar and good value for price

extraits.texte: I have put this on 3 times, and it has pilled all 3 times. I love the texture. I love the way that it feels when applying. But I can't have constant pilling all day. The first day I wore it, I thought it was just dry skin under my makeup. Yesterday, I didn't wear makeup and thought it was dry skin again. Today, it was obvious pilling, no makeup.

Perhaps I'm just not the ideal consumer for this product … I introduced this sorbet gel to my skincare routine about twice a week, with no other new products so as not to disturb its efficacy. My skin feels tight and dry following application, to the point of appearing red and splotchy. This sorbet offers absolutely no soothing effect. It feels as if I have just applied a harsh salicylic acid toner. Considering all the stellar reviews, I seem to be the outlier. I have tried other hydrating gels that provide much needed relief to parched skin. This product just isn't it.

M34 I've been using it for a couple of weeks now and the product does what it says. It mattifies without over-drying. My skin is very sensitive and it hasn't broken me out. It glides on the skin and is a thick formula. Almost feels like silicone, but then it soaks into the skin nicely instead of sitting on top.

I have a lot of particulars when it comes to texture of stuff I put on my skin, and this has to be my favorite. It leaves my skin soft and more importantly hydrated! I have terribly dry skin to the point where it makes all of the foundations I've ever tried inevitably flake and get patchy, but this fixed that! It absorbs easily and quite frankly, fun to play with. I'll happily buy this again.

I got this on sale or for free as a gift with purchase (I cant exactly remember but its not what I sought out to buy and got it with my order) and as someone with oily skin with visible pores its hard to find good moisturizers that wont irritate the skin and clog pores. Works well no shine slightly mattifying effect and its light weight. Use more often than some of my more costly products.

This product can be used AM or PM, under makeup or by itself. It provides a great moisture with a pretty matte finish. I didn't feel like it was overbearing, it was the perfect amount of moisture. There is no scent to the product which I like since I have acne prone skin. Which it also didn't cause any new breakouts which I appreciate.

I love how luxe this moisturizer feels at a reasonable price point. I find that it really does give me long-lasting hydration without making my face look like a greasy mess or moving around under my makeup. The salicylic acid keeps my skin clear as well!! New favorite
